title: Morton's piano, personality and Chicago dances
summary: He describes Morton's playing, boastful personality, riffs in King Porter, and playing his Chicago dance dates.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Remembering Jelly Roll Morton: the man, the band

blocks.x: How did he play piano when you first heard him say in Memphis? Was he really good then?

I liked him of course. Oh, wonderful. Good, good, uh, good. I liked that leaping bass he played. Oh, he was a wonderful piano player. He just amazed you when he first sat down. As we call it in the music world, he had some quips that wouldn't do.
Was he fairly easy to get along with or difficult, would you say? Some people say one and some of the others.

Well, Jell-A-Roll, uh, I got along with him. First, he was a sporting type of young fella, good looking to me, dressed well, had a diamond in his tube. And I always groomed his hair, had an automobile and a big yellow dog. And he was boastful. He was a great piano player. He says, I am great, and I know it, and he was great.
That's what I always thought too.

Yeah. I always thought of that. And he could do many, many, many things on the piano. And I think that he was the first to start what we call in music, riffs. And that first tune that he wrote, what was it? King Porter. King Porter, King Porter. If you see the piano part of King Porter, you'll see your first riffs. King Porter. And, uh, I don't know. That was when I heard him in Chicago. I didn't hear him. I don't know whether he got that from some of the bands in the South or not. But, uh, Jell-O Roll has always been around. Hillman, who knew him in New Orleans, uh, they played together. And they said he always played as a single, by himself mostly.
Did you ever work with him in a band up here? Yes, I have. Aside from the record that you made.
Yes, I played, played, uh, played with, uh, Jell-O Roll many times on dances, dance dates. It always went over big. Sensational.
I understood he had a band sometimes that go out of town and travel. Did you ever travel on any tour with him?

No, I didn't travel on any tour. Just around town. He would get a lot of dates himself. A lot of dance dates and pick his musicians. And every time he could, uh, cause I were, uh, the earlier part of the nights, generally I were, uh, in the theater. If there's any way that he could wake me in on the date. Uh, if it run late, well, he would do so. Uh huh.
